title: Sunday
hookLine: the Lord's day at the center of the week
tomorrow: how often is often enough for confession?

cards: Sunday night has a feeling people have named: the Sunday scaries, Monday leaning over everything. Other Sundays sound different. Bells.
A kitchen already warm after Mass. Too many chairs at one table, and someone's grandmother saying sit, sit, there's plenty. Nobody checks their email.
The Church says that second kind of Sunday isn't just a nice memory. It's the center of the week.

teach.h: THE FIRST DAY OF THE WEEK.
teach.b: Start with when. All four Gospels find the tomb empty on the first day of the week.
So the first Christians gathered then: Acts says, in the Douay-Rheims, "on the first day of the week, when we were assembled to break bread." By the last book of the Bible, the day has a name.
John writes, "I was in the spirit on the Lord's day." The Latin Bible calls it dominica dies. Sunday is the Lord's day because it's resurrection day.
An early Christian letter, the Epistle of Barnabas, calls it the eighth day, kept with gladness, the day Jesus rose: the first day of a new creation.
That's why it isn't the end of the week but its center: every other day leans on it. The commandment says, "Remember that thou keep holy the sabbath day."

teach.h: THE SABBATH, THEN THE LORD'S DAY.
teach.b: Jews keep the Sabbath on the seventh day; Christians keep the Lord's day on the first.
The Church asks two things of Sunday: go to Mass, and rest from work that crowds out worship, joy and rest.
The Mass can be on Sunday or Saturday evening. Then the rest: the long lunch, the walk, the nap, the call to your grandmother.

how: Catholics go to Mass on Sunday or Saturday evening and keep the day for rest, family and works of mercy, avoiding work that crowds out worship and rest.

o: the Lord's day, kept for resurrection, Mass and rest
a day off from work set by law for everyone

games.q: your club team schedules a tournament every Sunday morning this spring. what fits the Lord's day?
o: find a Saturday evening or Sunday night Mass, and guard some rest.
skip Mass for the season; playing sports already counts as rest.
quit the team, because Sunday rules out any games at all.
games.why: the Church asks for Mass, on Sunday or the evening before, and rest from work that crowds out worship. a game isn't forbidden; losing the center is the risk.

practice: Close your eyes and listen for the quietest sound in the room: a fan, a bird, your own breath. Let that be Sunday's sound for now, the sound of nothing being demanded of you.
Before you open your eyes, choose one hour next Sunday you'll keep clear.

wordCard.voice: Sunday. The Lord's day, resurrection day, the center the rest of the week leans on.

orig.note: Greek: of the Lord. the word for the Lord's day in the Apocalypse (1:10).

carryVoice: Keep this one: the center, not the week's end but the hub the other days turn on. Until tomorrow.
